dedupe_keys.name: cygma global gridded crop yields on dias future ssp rcp scenarios 1961 2100 and historical versus non warming climates 1961 2010

description: These two DIAS datasets give grid-cell yields of maize, rice, spring wheat and soybean at 0.5 degree resolution from the global gridded crop model CYGMA, for irrigated and rainfed conditions and also for cells not currently cultivated, so users can compute national yields under their own irrigation scenarios. The DataCite and DIAS pages say the future set covers 1961 to 2100 under SSP1, SSP2 and SSP3 with four RCPs for the CO2 fertilisation effect and bias-corrected CMIP5 climate, and the second set covers 1961 to 2010 under historical and non-warming counterfactual climates from MRI-AGCM3.2 (d4PDF), in tonnes per hectare. They were published in 2017 and 2018 by Toshichika Iizumi of the Institute for Agro-Environmental Sciences, NARO, under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence that both DIAS dataset pages state (the provider's policy asks to cite Iizumi and others 2017 or 2018), with no licence fee or cost stated. Coverage is global. Caveats: the DIAS page read on 2026-09-26 says data download is currently unavailable for the future set, so access is only by contacting the provider, and only spring wheat is modelled. For simulation they give climate change and attribution yield signals for food supply and agricultural loss scenarios. Related catalogue records include DSSAT, APSIM and the CLIMADA crop production exposure data.
